name: Melt Stack
description: Melt Stack: a 4-oscillator, 4-layer analog-modelling synth. Classic/Shaper/Digital oscillators, ring/sync/X-mod, ladder + MS-style filters, Layer Stack/Rotate, per-voice motion sequencer and a physics X/Y ball for modulation and vector blends. 12 original presets.
author: Meltdown Empire
